python_interfaces.name: TaskRepository
python_interfaces.rule: Task UUID/task_kind are immutable; repositories never commit internally

python_interfaces.name: WfmTaskRepository
python_interfaces.rule: Task No. is canonical attempt identity; one current owning RFC has append-only reassignment history; source projection is rebuildable from LLD-04; RETIRED Task Nos are permanent nonreuse authority

python_interfaces.name: TaskPlanRepository
python_interfaces.rule: plan revisions are immutable; current plan points to a newly accepted revision; Objective membership pins an exact accepted plan revision and never silently advances

python_interfaces.name: TaskExecutionRepository
python_interfaces.rule: execution evidence is append-only and current projection rebuildable. Exact no-history reads as execution_revision=0/not_started with no persisted projection/event. Any event requires a positive-revision projection, including corrected-to-not_started history; history/projection mismatch fails closed.

python_interfaces.name: TaskOutcomeRepository
python_interfaces.rule: accepted outcomes are completed|incomplete|cancelled_without_execution; Awaiting Review is derived, not accepted outcome

python_interfaces.name: TaskRelationshipRepository
python_interfaces.rule: direct SR/RFC links are Local-only; Device Reference links may belong to Local/WFM; history is preserved and targets are LLD-03 identities, never Network Element IDs

python_interfaces.name: TaskRetryRepository
python_interfaces.rule: every retry has one immediate predecessor; one attempt has at most one direct successor; retry identity is never reused

python_interfaces.name: TaskActivityLineageRepository
python_interfaces.rule: reviewed activity lineage supports competing-WFM detection; missing lineage never authorizes collapsing distinct Task Nos

python_interfaces.name: ObjectiveRepository
python_interfaces.rule: objective_id/MW identity never change; supersession/archive preserve row/history

python_interfaces.name: ObjectiveMembershipRepository
python_interfaces.rule: one Task has at most one current Objective; membership pins the exact reviewed Task-plan revision and history preserves prior Objective/plan context

python_interfaces.name: ObjectiveProjectionRepository
python_interfaces.rule: envelope/aggregate are transactional rebuildable projections; overlap uses indexed start < candidate_end AND end > candidate_start

python_interfaces.name: GroupingProposalRepository
python_interfaces.rule: proposal membership is persisted row-wise, exact and revision-bound; rejection suppression uses exact material-input fingerprint

python_interfaces.name: HistoricalObjectiveProposalRepository
python_interfaces.rule: provider Complete + valid source plan may suggest historical structure when no conflicting current operational plan exists; exact matching plan may be reused, otherwise AcceptHistoricalObjectiveProposal alone may create historical_source_structure plan; proposal/import never records execution/outcome/Inventory

python_interfaces.name: ObjectiveReviewRepository
python_interfaces.rule: review stores reviewed_at plus exact membership/outcome fingerprint and aggregate snapshot; later material correction invalidates currentness without editing old review

python_interfaces.name: OperationalCountInclusionRepository
python_interfaces.rule: exclusion is reporting-only and never deletes Task/Objective/source/audit history

python_interfaces.name: ObjectiveTimezoneService
python_interfaces.rule: setting change never mutates persisted Task/Objective instants; wall-clock preservation requires reviewed Task plan revisions

python_interfaces.name: WfmImportReader
python_interfaces.rule: matches LLD-04; RETIRED is never adoption/create target; base token covers identity/current RFC/source projection/current plan/membership/lock revisions relevant to proposal

python_interfaces.name: WfmImportMutationService
python_interfaces.contract: caller supplies outer LLD-04 UoW/receipt. Exact Task No. adopts existing WFM; source projection changes no execution/outcome/membership; reviewed source plan appends Task plan but never silently repins Objective membership; mismatch becomes regroup input.

python_interfaces.name: RfcTerminalTaskParticipant
python_interfaces.contract: preview/revalidate own exact Task/Objective impact; apply uses caller UoW after proof/outer receipt and returns only bounded summary; hard-delete classification is read-only; participant never commits

python_interfaces.name: RfcHistoryRiskProvider
python_interfaces.rule: read-only in Snapshot or writer UoW. READY returns LOW|HIGH, exact evidence count and fingerprint; INDETERMINATE fails closed. Exact evidence semantics are owned by interfaces/cross-packet-v2.json; no Task/WFM/Objective rows cross into LLD-03.

python_interfaces.name: InventoryTaskDependencyProvider
python_interfaces.rule: matches LLD-07; LLD-05 never rewrites Inventory history; protected Inventory history blocks Task hard delete; retry copies only explicitly selected current eligible planning relationships

python_interfaces.name: TaskOperationalEvidenceReader
python_interfaces.rule: read-only accepted operational evidence; consumers cannot mutate Task lifecycle through it

consumed_existing_interfaces: LLD-03 RFC identity/lifecycle/hierarchy plus terminal-cascade snapshot/review/context/apply-summary contracts
LLD-04 immutable source evidence/proposal authority through WfmImportReader/WfmImportMutationService
cross_domain_transaction_rule: Cross-domain mutations use caller UoW/receipt and never commit/rollback independently; RFC terminal revalidation precedes proof/apply; RFC history/hard-delete providers are read-only.
reader_contract: Authoritative decisions re-read through supplied current reader; expensive previews use stable snapshots plus exact fingerprints/revisions for commit-time revalidation.
